question: Who is Osei Tweneboah and what does he research? Is it data science or more pure math?
answer:
Osei Tweneboah is an Associate Professor of Data Science in the School of Science, Nursing, and Health. [6] His talk, “Can We Predict Which Students Won’t Show Up? A Data Science Approach to College Enrollment,” explores “summer melt”—students who commit to enroll but do not show up. It uses real admissions data and machine-learning techniques to identify students at risk of not enrolling, focusing on how data-driven insights can support institutional decisions, student engagement, and enrollment outcomes. [8]

The work described is applied data science, not pure mathematics: the page explicitly describes it as a data science approach to a real-world education problem. It does not describe this research as pure math. [8]

Contact: otwenebo@ramapo.edu; (201) 684-7332; office ASB-411. Office hours: “In-person or Virtual. Thur. 11am-1pm; Fri. 10am-11am or by Appointment.” [6]

Sources: [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/faculty/osei-tweneboah/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/research-and-scholarship/faculty-scholarship-symposium-series/)

question: I'm an English major hoping to do an independent study in creative writing. Who teaches fiction writing here, and how do I reach them?
answer:
James Hoch, Professor of Creative Writing in the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education, lists “Fiction Writing” among his courses. [3] Contact him at jhoch1@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7244; office B-135. Office hours: “MR 1:00-2:00 pm, 4:00-5:00 pm; W 12:00-4:00 pm by Appointment.” [3]

For an independent study, choose a topic not covered in the standard curriculum; only under extraordinary circumstances may it cover a topic that is. You may not use independent study for a course offered in the regular schedule that semester. [8][9][11] Obtain an Independent Study Registration Form from the Registrar; have the instructor and sponsoring school’s dean complete it, then return it to the Registrar’s Office. Complete a contract form too, stating the purpose, objective, grading criteria, work-hour guidelines, discipline and level, and title/credits. Submit by the last day of add/drop in the academic calendar; registrations are not accepted afterward. [9][11] Undergraduate students may not enroll in more than FOUR (4) credits in a semester, including summer or winter, and normally may not exceed eight credits over their career. If on academic probation or warning, you need the Dean’s permission. [11]

Registrar: reg@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7695. [11]

Sources: [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/ahe/faculty/james-hoch/) [8](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#independent-study1) [9](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#independent-study1) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/registrationinfo/)
